features.name: Governed learning and practice with learner agency
Bounded AI and optional human support

dependencies.na: Current user-support semantics mutate Core-owned learner/account product state and require no material external service crossing; authentication or optional notification/telemetry is not a support dependency.

Current operational visibility is a Core-authorized view of Core-owned content/work/provider-reconciliation state; optional external telemetry delivery is operational evidence, not a material product dependency.
Approved operating-policy administration mutates typed Core-owned policy and explicitly excludes raw secret/environment editing; no material external provider crossing is required.

interfaces.na: Consequential privileged audit reconciliation is Core-internal within SYS-002 and crosses no material runtime/trust/ownership interface boundary.

dependencies.na: Consequential privileged audit reconciliation is Core-internal; an audited operation's earlier provider use does not make the audit record itself depend on that provider.

decisions.subject: Core product authority and deterministic policy
decisions.outcome: Build product semantics and authoritative policy in Core rather than delegate them to external providers.

decisions.subject: Commodity infrastructure boundaries
decisions.outcome: Use selected external identity, PostgreSQL hosting, and bounded task dispatch only behind Core-owned authority boundaries.

decisions.subject: Evaluator provider boundary
decisions.outcome: Keep evaluation authority in the project-owned Evaluator while buying bounded external AI and speech execution behind provider-neutral adapters.

decisions.subject: Detailed product feature completeness surface
decisions.outcome: Use FTR-007..FTR-046 as the exact 40 learner detailed feature units and FTR-047..FTR-053 as the seven minimum privileged surface features; retain FTR-001..FTR-006 as historical macro anchors and keep neighboring abstractions out of FTR identity.

decisions.subject: Governed object/media artifact custody
decisions.outcome: Keep artifact identity, lifecycle, access and usability in Core while using the accepted external object/media boundary only for byte custody and bounded transfer.

decisions.subject: Commercial entitlement reconciliation
decisions.outcome: Keep effective entitlement authority in Core and treat external payment/subscription state only as authenticated and reconciled observations.

decisions.subject: Secret custody and security administration
decisions.outcome: Keep security authorization and secret-operation policy in Core while using external secret custody for credential material behind audited least-privilege access.
